candidates.title: Formula-level repaired-JPR EC key certificate

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: One formula-level key with exact algorithms and proofs for joins, collision, joint success, replay, and cost, or one exact reachable counterexample/cost obstruction for that key.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: No implementation or execution; identify the first missing formula or theorem.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Any absent key, target-trained advice, L^2 materialization, success ceiling, unproved independence, lost coefficient lineage, unknown Pareto axis used as dominance, or unverified source forces REVISE.
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: All three independent reviews and the Coordinator ledger disposition are durably archived.

resource_estimate.dominant_cost: Static key construction, theorem/cost derivation, adversarial review, and archival.
resource_estimate.complexity_hypothesis: Zero experimental computation; formula-level theorem/design and finite static controls only.
resource_estimate.sharding_plan: One producer, one snapshot, three parallel mutually blind reviews, one ledger archive.
resource_estimate.stop_rule: Stop after one complete packet and three terminal reviews; stop positive interpretation on any missing key, join, collision, success, replay, or cost clause.
